B: Great. Could I ask about the rent?
A: The rent is six hundred and fifty pounds a month — no, sorry, it went up last week, it's now six hundred and eighty pounds, and that includes water but not electricity.

B: When could I view it?

B: Thursday at four works for me.
A: Perfect. Can I take your name and number to confirm?
B: Sure, it's Rachel Maddox — M-A-D-D-O-X.
A: Got it. And a contact number?
B: 0791 442 3087.
A: Wonderful, Rachel. I'll send a confirmation text before Thursday. Please bring photo ID to the viewing, and note that pets aren't allowed in the building.
stem: What is the main purpose of the woman's phone call?
options: To ask about a flat for rent
explain_zh: 女子打電話是要詢問一間出租公寓的細節，包括租金與看房時間，屬於典型的租屋詢問對話。其他選項如繳租金、報修、取消看房都沒有在對話中出現。掌握開場白就能抓住通話目的。

A: No previous experience is needed, but please bring your own apron and a container to take food home.
B: Got it. Can I register now?

B: 0783 219 5561.
A: We'll email your confirmation within two days. The class is held in Room 4B, and there's a maximum of twelve students, so it fills up fast. Also, note the course is fully booked for November, so this October session is your best option.

options: To register for a cooking course

passage:
A: Good evening, The Olive Branch restaurant, how can I help you?
B: Hi, I'd like to book a table for Friday night.
A: Certainly. How many people, and what time?
B: Six people, around seven thirty.
A: Let me check... Friday at seven thirty for six — I'm sorry, we're actually full at that time, but we do have a table at eight forty-five, or seven o'clock if that works.
B: Seven o'clock is fine.
A: Great. Will you need a high chair or anything special?
B: Yes, one high chair for a toddler, and could we sit somewhere away from the kitchen door? My father doesn't like the noise.
A: No problem, I'll note a quiet table with a high chair. Can I have a name for the booking?
B: Yes, it's under Priya Chandrasekaran — that's C-H-A-N-D-R-A-S-E-K-A-R-A-N.
A: Thank you. And a contact number in case we need to reschedule?
B: 0762 384 1190.
A: All set, Priya. Table for six, Friday at seven p.m., with a high chair and a quiet spot. We also offer a ten percent discount if you mention our loyalty card when you arrive.
stem: What is the woman calling about?
explain_zh: 女子打電話是為了訂週五晚上的餐廳位子，這是整段對話最明確的主旨。其餘選項如外帶、應徵工作在對話中完全沒有出現。

passage:

B: Hi, I think I left my backpack on the train from Manchester yesterday evening.
A: Okay, can you describe the bag?

B: I was in carriage C, seat 14.
A: Thanks. Can I take your name and number so we can call you if it turns up?
B: It's Oliver Bramwell — B-R-A-M-W-E-L-L.
A: And your number?
B: 0798 553 2246.
A: We'll check the lost property store and call you within forty-eight hours. If it's found, there's a small handling fee of five pounds to collect it. In the meantime, please also report it online in case another station finds it first.
stem: Why is the man contacting the lost property office?
explain_zh: 男子打電話是要通報他把背包遺留在火車上，這是對話最主要的目的。其他選項如買票或抱怨誤點都沒有在對話中出現。

B: Hi, I'd like to drop off a suit and a wool coat for cleaning.
A: Sure. The suit is twelve pounds and the coat is eighteen pounds, so that's thirty pounds together.
B: There's also a stain on the coat sleeve, is that extra?
A: Yes, stain removal is an additional eight pounds, so actually the total comes to thirty-eight pounds.
B: Okay, that's fine. When will they be ready?
A: Normally two days, but since it's a stain treatment, it'll take three days, ready by Thursday afternoon.
B: Great, thank you.
A: Can I have your name for the ticket?
B: It's Desmond Achterberg — A-C-H-T-E-R-B-E-R-G.
A: And a phone number in case of any issues?
B: 0768 441 9902.
A: Thanks, Desmond. Please keep this ticket, as we can't release the items without it, and note we close early at four p.m. on Thursdays.
stem: What is required to collect the cleaned items?
explain_zh: 店員在最後提醒一定要保留取件單，因為沒有它無法領取衣物。這題考驗聽出結尾的注意事項細節。

passage:
A: Hi, welcome to QuickFix Phone Repairs.
B: Hi, my phone screen is cracked, can you fix it?
A: Sure, what model is it?
B: It's a Galaxy S22.
A: Okay, screen replacement for that model is fifty-five pounds, and it usually takes about two hours.
B: Is there a cheaper option?
A: There's a basic glass-only repair for thirty-five pounds, but actually that one isn't compatible with your model, so the full screen replacement is your only option.
B: Alright, I'll go with that then.
A: Great. We also need to check the battery, that's a free inspection. Can I get your name?
B: It's Alina Kowalczyk — K-O-W-A-L-C-Z-Y-K.
A: And your number, in case we need to reach you?
B: 0781 226 5507.
A: Thanks, Alina. Your phone will be ready by five p.m. today. Please back up your data beforehand, as we're not responsible for any data loss during repair.
stem: What problem does the woman have?
explain_zh: 女子的手機螢幕破裂，這是對話一開始就說明的問題。其餘選項如電池沒電、無法開機都沒有在對話中提到。

passage:
A: Hi, I'd like to sign up for a library card.
B: Sure, do you live in this borough?
A: Yes, I just moved here last month.
B: Great, I'll need proof of address and photo ID. Do you have those with you?
A: Yes, here's my ID and a utility bill.
B: Perfect. The card itself is free for residents, but if you want to borrow DVDs and games, there's normally an annual fee of fifteen pounds — oh wait, actually that fee was removed last year, so DVD borrowing is free too now.
A: Oh, that's great.
B: You can borrow up to eight books at a time, for three weeks. Can I get your name for the card?
A: It's Samuel Ezenwa — E-Z-E-N-W-A.
B: And a phone number, in case a reserved book arrives?
A: 0793 117 6642.
B: Thanks, Samuel. Your card will be ready in about ten minutes, and it's valid for five years before it needs renewing.
stem: What does the man want to do?
options: Sign up for a library card
explain_zh: 男子是要辦理一張圖書館借閱證，這是對話一開始就說明的目的。其餘選項如歸還逾期書籍、預約自修室都沒有出現在對話中。
